children: The annual inflation rate in Colombia rose to 6.29% in September 2026 from 6.24% in August, falling short of market expectations of 6.32% but marking the highest reading since July 2024.

The latest figure pushed further above the central bank’s target of 3%, driven by stronger price growth for furniture and household maintenance (6.75% vs 6.67% in August), transport (5.27% vs 5.25%), food and non-alcoholic beverages (6.74% vs 6.10%), education (7.49% vs 7.45%), and restaurants and hotels (9.44% vs 9.36%).
Housing and utilities inflation was unchanged at 5.74%.

Meanwhile, price growth eased for information and communication (4.45% vs 5.97%), recreation and culture (4.91% vs 4.98%), miscellaneous goods and services (5.63% vs 6.05%), alcoholic beverages and tobacco (6.05% vs 6.94%), clothing and footwear (3.12% vs 3.26%), and health (7.79% vs 8.30%).
On a monthly basis, consumer prices rose by 0.37% in September, slowing from a 0.39% gain in the preceding period.

title: Colombia Inflation Hits Over 2-Year High
